Granular_Parotoid_Glands.description: Embedded within the creature's thick, warty skin, these granular parotoid glands secrete a viscous, toxic slime that grants the amphibian a potent poison resistance and the ability to unleash a noxious poison cloud, enhancing its endurance and hardiness against the harsh realities of the dark fantasy realm.

Slippery_Mucous_Sheath.description: The Slippery Mucous Sheath is a glistening, gelatinous layer that envelops the entity, allowing it to slide effortlessly through the most treacherous terrain and retain water, granting it resilience in arid conditions, while its slick surface boosts its evasion, making it nearly impossible to catch.

Aposematic_Warning_Skin.description: This amphibian's vivid, dart frog-inspired skin pulses with an otherworldly glow, a stark warning to any predator of the potent neurotoxins coursing beneath its surface, while its charm and charisma might draw admirers closer to their doom, yet it hinders their ability to remain unseen in the wild.

Cryptic_Mossy_Hide.description: The Cryptic Mossy Hide is a chameleon-like skin that pulses with the hues of the forest, allowing the Mossy Frog to blend seamlessly with the undergrowth, its mossy exterior granting an innate advantage in stealth and ambush tactics.

Osteoderm_Embedded_Skin.description: The Osteoderm_Embedded_Skin is a thick, chitinous layer that glistens with a sickly sheen, seamlessly blending natural armor plating with the amphibian’s moist, horned skin, granting it an additional layer of protection and the innate ability to block attacks.

Desiccation_Resistant_Cocoon.description: This thick, chitin-like cocoon, spun from the spadefoot toad's own skin, not only serves as a protective shell but also as a remarkable reservoir, storing vital moisture and enhancing the amphibian's endurance in arid environments, granting it resilience against the harshest desiccation.

Heavily_Warty_Epidermis.description: The Heavily_Warty_Epidermis is a thick, bumpy hide covered in numerous toxic warts, reminiscent of an amphibian toad, offering natural armor but reducing one's charisma due to its unappealing appearance.

Bioluminescent_Warning_Sheath.description: This amphibian's translucent, bioluminescent sheath glows with an otherworldly light, serving as both a mesmerizing allure and a warning to predators, though it also makes stealthier movements more difficult.

Keratinized_Spiny_Tubercles.description: Embedded deep within the amphibian's skin, keratinized spiny tubercles form a formidable natural armor, enhancing both its defensive capabilities and physical prowess, while granting the creature a lethal edge through the ability to inflict bleeding wounds with its barbed protrusions.

Translucent_Glass_Venter.description: The Translucent_Glass_Venter component endows its host with the ghostly, nearly invisible skin of a glass frog, granting exceptional stealth in its natural habitat while subtly impairing their constitution, reflecting the fragility of their translucent yet vulnerable nature.
